description: The dead monumental stone layer — xanmeer massing and Barsaebic ruin frontage, built from the Ayleid Ruins Building Kit's 85-piece EXTERIOR subset: blocks and quad blocks for stacked terraces, stairs (side/centre/spiral) for sculpted stairways, statue walls and bases for carved frontage, bridges for stone causeways, towers and columns. Stone is a moral error for modern Argonians post-Duskfall, so this kit is for RUINS only and must never mix with a settlement kit. Keep the Barsaebic Ayleid and xanmeer historical layers distinguishable when placing from it. Round 5 adds Here There Be Monsters' xanmeer ruin set — three mesoamerican pyramid statics, the feathered-serpent and serpent-sigil statues, a goddess statue, gargoyle, runic stone, free walls/corners, totems and a skull stack. These are the ORNAMENTAL frontage the Ayleid kit's plain geometry lacked, and the submerged ruin static doubles into the drowned layer. EXCEPTION (Phase 11 Part 6, 2026-09-04): Mazzatun is canon's one LIVE stone settlement (the Xit-Xaht building under a sap-enslaved Hist); its `argonian-stone` kit set draws on this tileset for courses, blocks, stairs and towers as a building site, not a ruin. The rule stands everywhere else.
